description: Retarget the stale source-grep test, add a createSignedInvoice reachability assertion and redeem-preserved assertions, extend the navigation test, and update the docs in the same change. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (file names and symbols).
steps: Edit scripts/tests/retry-payment-orphan.test.mjs: replace the test 'merchant receive keeps the verified-signer creation gate' (lines ~384-388) so it reads src/hooks/use-merchant-invoice-flow.ts and asserts /isVerifiedMerchantWallet/ and /Complete wallet recovery/ plus that createSignedInvoice receives merchantId from merchantEntityId; also assert src/app/(merchant)/receive.tsx uses useMerchantInvoiceFlow. Retarget, never weaken (the two original regexes must remain).

In the same file add a reachability test: a small helper that walks '@/...' imports (resolving .ts, .tsx, /index.ts, /index.tsx under src/) breadth-first from src/app/(merchant)/receive.tsx and asserts src/services/invoice-service.ts is reachable; assert src/app/(merchant)/_layout.tsx contains name="receive" and name="redeem"; assert MerchantBottomNavigation.tsx still routes the QR Scan item to '/(merchant)/receive'.

In the same file add a redeem-preserved test: src/app/(merchant)/redeem.tsx contains useOfflineSync, executeVoucherRedemption, BeneficiaryScannerView and 'RC-OFF-V1:'; receive.tsx does not import MerchantRedemption.

Edit src/app/navigation-back-behavior.test.mjs: add assertions that MerchantBottomNavigation routes QR Scan with router.navigate('/(merchant)/receive') and supports active === 'qr', and that receive.tsx and redeem.tsx use router.canGoBack().
Search scripts/tests and src for any other test that greps receive.tsx for scanner/redemption/offline strings (earlier search found none) and retarget any found to redeem.tsx.

Docs per plan section 6. docs/flow-reliefchain.md: MR2 node names the route; add MR7 'Scan and redeem a voucher (DB-only)' node with 🟡 and a style line; scope-matrix row for Bluetooth & Offline sync now references redeem.tsx; add a scope-matrix row for merchant scan-and-redeem labeled database-only (first re-read the LATEST execute_voucher_redemption definition in supabase/migrations/20261004020000_update_redemption_and_history.sql and 20261004010000_... and describe exactly what it does; do not claim an on-chain transaction); one-line corrections of the stale cash-only gate wording (prepare-payment/index.ts:83-84 accepts cash and voucher; client creates cash invoices only; contract-deployment prerequisites unchanged and not re-verified). docs/sprint-reliefchain.md: add a §8 change-log row with today's date and reason (f978c77 replaced the invoice screen; restored at (merchant)/receive; scanner moved to (merchant)/redeem; no story added/removed/reprioritised), update MER-02 text with the redeem route and an honest note that the RPC produces a database-only hash so the on-chain criterion is not met by that path, without silently changing MER-02 Done status or editing criteria. docs/sad-reliefchain.md: (merchant) route list at line ~62 = index, receive, redeem, history, payment-history, profile, edit-profile, programs, security, wallet-recovery, transactions; fix the funding-gate wording at lines ~171 and ~267 in one line each. docs/prd-reliefchain.md line ~61: same route list. docs/relief-chain.md: one factual sentence under Step 6 (~line 320) that, as built, the merchant presents a signed invoice QR which the beneficiary scans and pays (Stellar testnet, cash rail) and that scanning a beneficiary QR is a separate database-only redemption path. Do not add numbers, partners, or capabilities.
Run all verification commands. Do NOT commit. Set this FEAT's status to completed and record results in findings.
